spans.quote: For eight weeks, I read a chapter before looking at my phone in the morning.
I expected the change to help me remember more of what I read.

constraints.preservation_rule: Eight weeks; a chapter before phone use in the morning; expected memory benefit. Read alongside the explicit lapses, not as perfect daily adherence.

spans.quote: At the end of the eight weeks, I could recall the plots of three novels, but I had not tested my memory before the experiment.
I therefore cannot tell whether my recall actually improved.

constraints.preservation_rule: Three novels' plots recalled at end; no baseline memory test; improvement unknown. Do not conclude improvement or no improvement.

spans.quote: The change I noticed was simpler: I stopped interrupting a chapter to check messages.

constraints.preservation_rule: Observed no mid-chapter message checking and liked it. Preserve personal reaction; do not claim measured concentration, productivity, health, or memory gains.

spans.quote: I still checked my phone as soon as I finished, and on two mornings I skipped reading altogether.
This was a routine I tried, not a rule I consistently followed.

constraints.preservation_rule: Still checked immediately after finishing; skipped reading on two mornings; inconsistent adherence. The summary may be rephrased but its qualification must remain.

spans.quote: I am reluctant to recommend the same routine to everyone.
My mornings were quiet during those weeks, and I did not try it when I was travelling.

constraints.preservation_rule: Retain reluctance to recommend universally, quiet mornings, and untested travel context. Do not broaden to a universal prescription.

spans.quote: The reading itself was worthwhile to me even without evidence of a memory benefit.
Next month I want to try reading after dinner instead, although I have not chosen a start date.

constraints.preservation_rule: Reading worthwhile regardless of absent memory evidence; desire to try after dinner next month; start date unchosen. Desire is not a scheduled commitment or completed experiment.

unresolved: Memory improvement and applicability to travel remain unknown; the next attempt has no selected start date. Leave these unresolved rather than inventing results or a schedule.
